# TikTok item_list fixture provenance

`item_list_normal.json` is a sanitized, structure-preserving subset of a manually
observed TikTok `/api/post/item_list/` response generated by the page itself.

- Acquisition was passive; no additional TikTok API request was generated.
- Real creator and video identities were replaced.
- Signed/media URLs, creator objects, tracking data, and log identifiers were removed.
- Request URLs, query parameters, headers, cookies, and authorization data are not included.
- Parser field paths and their observed JSON value types are preserved.

Negative parser cases are synthetic variants derived from this fixture in tests.
